name: Villanueva de la Vera (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de la Vera (a castle on red between stars).
history: The arms were published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura no. 85 of 24 July 2001 and the flag was approved officially on 12 February 2003; it is a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of a red cloth charged with the municipal arms.

features.role: Villanueva de la Vera arms — castle between stars
